FAIL P2-1 absent P(best) omits simulation claim: The input was expected to not match the regular expression /P\(best\) uses/. Input:

'Contrast-based network meta-analysis used generalised least squares with a common-effect inverse-variance model. Entered effects represent the second treatment minus the first, already on the analysis scale; no arm-count conversion or continuity correction is performed. Complete multi-arm comparisons are grouped by study and correlated contrasts use arm variances; the random-effects covariance adds half the between-study variance to shared contrasts. Invalid or inconsistent multi-arm designs are refused. Effects and 95% confidence limits are displayed on the entered analysis scale. Confidence intervals and two-sided tests use the normal Wald approximation. No Hartung–Knapp adjustment is applied. Heterogeneity is reported as Q with chi-squared tests, the DerSimonian–Laird between-study variance and its square root, and I² with a Higgins–Thompson interval through H. I² is the nonnegative Q-based proportion of excess variation. Q is decomposed into within-design heterogeneity and between-design inconsistency. Prediction intervals are not displayed for the common-effect model. P-scores average pairwise certainty derived from the selected model’s two-sided tests; smaller estimates rank better. P(best) uses 10,000 multivariate-normal draws of the fitted effects with their covariance and a fixed random seed. '
